description: Average the stored season-to-date running win count over each country's standings rows.

d.request: For each country, calculate the mean constructorStandings.wins (season-to-date running count) across all constructorStandings rows for races in that country, identify countries whose country-mean exceeds the overall mean of country-means, then among those identify countries whose country-mean also exceeds the mean of that filtered group, and output the mean country-mean of this final subset, the mean excess over the overall mean, and the mean excess over the filtered group's mean.
d.sql:
WITH country_means AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as country_mean_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_mean_wins) as overall_mean_value
  FROM country_means
),
filtered_once AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.country,
    cm.country_mean_wins,
    om.overall_mean_value
  FROM country_means cm
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE cm.country_mean_wins > om.overall_mean_value
),
filtered_group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_mean_wins) as filtered_group_mean_value
  FROM filtered_once
),
filtered_twice AS (
  SELECT 
    fo.country,
    fo.country_mean_wins,
    fo.overall_mean_value,
    fgm.filtered_group_mean_value
  FROM filtered_once fo
  CROSS JOIN filtered_group_mean fgm
  WHERE fo.country_mean_wins > fgm.filtered_group_mean_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(country_mean_wins) as mean_country_mean_of_final_subset,
  AVG(country_mean_wins - overall_mean_value) as mean_excess_over_overall_mean,
  AVG(country_mean_wins - filtered_group_mean_value) as mean_excess_over_filtered_group_mean
FROM filtered_twice

a.request: Link constructor standings to their races and circuits. For each circuit country, compute the average of `constructorStandings.wins` as stored (the season-to-date running count of wins) across that country's standings rows. Keep the countries whose average is above the mean of all country averages, and note how far each is above it. Among those, keep the countries whose average is also above the mean of the kept countries' averages, and note how far each is above that second mean. Return one row with three unrounded values: the mean of these final countries' average wins, the mean of their excess over the all-country mean, and the mean of their excess over the above-average group's mean.
a.sql:
WITH country_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_all FROM country_avgs
),
above_all_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.country,
    ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avgs ca, all_mean
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > all_mean.mean_all
),
above_group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_above_all FROM above_all_mean
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    aam.country,
    aam.avg_wins
  FROM above_all_mean aam, above_group_mean
  WHERE aam.avg_wins > above_group_mean.mean_above_all
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fc.avg_wins) as mean_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(fc.avg_wins - am.mean_all) as mean_excess_over_all,
  AVG(fc.avg_wins - agm.mean_above_all) as mean_excess_over_above_all
FROM final_countries fc, all_mean am, above_group_mean agm

c.request: For each country where races are held, look at the average constructor wins per standings entry at its races. Take the countries above the overall average, and then those of them that are also above the average of that above-average group. Give one row with three unrounded figures: the mean of those countries' average wins, the mean of how far they exceed the overall average, and the mean of how far they exceed the above-average group's average. Average the stored season-to-date running win count over each country's standings rows.
c.sql: WITH country_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_value FROM country_avgs), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ca.avg_wins > oa.overall_avg_value), above_overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_overall_avg_value FROM above_overall), top_countries AS (SELECT ao.country, ao.avg_wins FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN above_overall_avg aoa WHERE ao.avg_wins > aoa.above_overall_avg_value) SELECT AVG(tc.avg_wins) as mean_avg_wins, AVG(tc.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg_value) as mean_exceed_overall, AVG(tc.avg_wins - aoa.above_overall_avg_value) as mean_exceed_above_avg FROM top_countries tc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN above_overall_avg aoa

b.request: For each country where races are held, average the constructorStandings.wins values (season-to-date running counts) across all standings entries from races in that country; filter to countries exceeding the overall average of country-level averages; then filter those to countries also exceeding the average of the filtered group; return the mean of their averages, the mean of their excess above the overall average, and the mean of their excess above the filtered group average.
b.sql:
WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as country_avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as overall_average
  FROM country_averages
),
first_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg_wins
  FROM country_averages ca, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ca.country_avg_wins > oa.overall_average
),
first_filtered_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as filtered_average
  FROM first_filtered
),
final_filtered AS (
  SELECT ff.country, ff.country_avg_wins
  FROM first_filtered ff, first_filtered_avg ffa
  WHERE ff.country_avg_wins > ffa.filtered_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ff.country_avg_wins) as mean_of_averages,
  AVG(ff.country_avg_wins - oa.overall_average) as mean_excess_above_overall,
  AVG(ff.country_avg_wins - ffa.filtered_average) as mean_excess_above_filtered
FROM final_filtered ff, overall_avg oa, first_filtered_avg ffa
